title: Skeleton and Octopus on Cliff
description: A hooded skeleton in a dark blue robe stands in a wooden boat with one hand extended, next to a large pink octopus creature with big eyes and a toothy grin that has several tentacles wrapped around the boat. The boat rests on a rocky cliff covered in yellow grass that floats in a cosmic sky filled with green and purple swirling nebulae, stars, and clouds.
prompt: A hooded skeleton wearing a dark blue robe stands inside a wooden boat with one bony hand extended outward, positioned next to a large bright pink octopus creature that has huge shiny black eyes, a wide toothy grin, and multiple curling tentacles wrapped around the boat. The boat sits on a rocky floating cliff covered in bright yellow grass, all set against a dark cosmic background filled with swirling green and purple nebulae, glowing stars, and white clouds.
